newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ConsRutile plans on Sierra Leone start.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ConsRutile plans on Sierra Leone start.

text.p: Consolidated Rutile Ltd said on Thursday detailed planning has begun towards restarting its 50 percent owned Sierra Rutile Ltd mine in Sierra Leone in West Africa.
"Recently, there have been a number of positive developments for the resumption of operations," the company said in a statement accompanying its half-year results.
However, a number of preconditions for a restart had yet to be finalised.
These included site security and the safety of personnel, and the refinancing of the current debt of Sierra Rutile as well as additional debt to repair and expand the mine.
Operations at the mine, which is half-owned by U.S.-based Nord Resources Corp, were suspended when it was over-run by rebel forces in January 1995.
ConsRutile is 50.14 percent owned by Cudgen RZ Ltd, which is majority owned by RGC Ltd.
RGC has previously estimated the cost of restarting the mine at A$25 million.
However, an A$80 million refinancing plan would be needed to rehabilitate the mine and complete the expansion plan, it has said.
